description: This file defines a Go struct for configuring an iSCSI Persistent Volume Source in Kubernetes, including builder methods for setting fields and documentation comments.

classes.name: ISCSIPersistentVolumeSourceApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A declarative configuration struct for Kubernetes iSCSI persistent volume source, with chainable setter methods.

methods.name: ISCSIPersistentVolumeSource
methods.description: Constructor function returning a new instance of the configuration struct.

methods.name: WithTargetPortal
methods.description: Sets the target portal address for the iSCSI volume configuration.

methods.name: WithIQN
methods.description: Sets the iSCSI Qualified Name for the volume.

methods.name: WithLun
methods.description: Sets the LUN number for the iSCSI volume.

methods.name: WithISCSIInterface
methods.description: Sets the network interface used for iSCSI transport.

methods.name: WithFSType
methods.description: Sets the filesystem type for the volume.

methods.name: WithReadOnly
methods.description: Sets whether the volume is mounted as read-only.

methods.name: WithPortals
methods.description: Adds one or more portal addresses to the configuration.

methods.name: WithDiscoveryCHAPAuth
methods.description: Enables or disables discovery CHAP authentication.

methods.name: WithSessionCHAPAuth
methods.description: Enables or disables session CHAP authentication.

methods.name: WithSecretRef
methods.description: Sets the secret reference for CHAP authentication.

methods.name: WithInitiatorName
methods.description: Sets a custom iSCSI initiator name.
